manifest.lifecycle: retrospective mechanism decomposition after the P439 total-M result; not a prospective model freeze
manifest.sensitivity_context: pooled_root; reuse each original full and delete-one root, do not refit or select roots
manifest.normalization: Both components retain the original total sample denominator, not within-family counts. H_k(p)=Pr[Binomial(N,p)>=k].
manifest.K_A: Reuse immutable same-stream angular_K_A_activity point and paired delete-one vectors from the source; no new observer fit.
manifest.raw_sources: The four source.runs records pin each raw archive commit, path, SHA256 and original sample counts; they are copied into score.json.
manifest.covariance: Delete the same paired batch from both directions; K_A uses that exact existing delete-one ID. Generations are independent blocks. Recompute all nine adjacent wedges and preserve their full singular covariance; do not count the additive total wedges as independent coordinates.
manifest.interpretation: Direct and plateau are correlated partitions of the same paths, not independent microscopic sources. Opposite noisy signs alone are not evidence for resolved cancellation.

post_score_change: Only report-generator prose and scientific interpretation were added after the single numerical pass; numerical code and numerical results were not changed or rerun. script_sha256 records the actual execution version.
scientific_conclusion: At current precision both family loadings remain unresolved, rather than two individually resolved large contributions cancelling: direct max abs(z)=1.1092, plateau max abs(z)=1.2776; joint component-zero chi2=4.6900476/8, p=.7901321. This is not proof of exact zero or exclusion of all cancellation mechanisms.
next_output: A paired same-stream M/K_A loading interval on a geometry whose canonical unmarked M contrast is already separately resolved; reuse compatible birth archives first. More K_A-only N1360 data do not repair unresolved M loading.
